text: A trifid code puts the 26 letters and ? in a 3 x 3 x 3 cube and mixes the three coordinates of neighbouring letters in groups: a sculptor's cipher. Groups of up to 15 letters were already ruled out (0040).

Every group length from 16 to the whole text, every starting place: each known letter ties its three coordinates to coordinates of carved letters; merging the ties and filling the cube so no two letters share a place decides each setting.
No cube fits K4, or any scrambled copy, at any setting; a planted text's cube is found. F4.2 closed.
